dedupe_keys.name: wave surge and tsunami overland hazard loading and structural response for developed shorelines array and debris loading tests

description: Wave, Surge, and Tsunami Overland Hazard, Loading and Structural Response for Developed Shorelines: Array and Debris Loading Tests is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Andrew Kennedy, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). Prediction of surge, wave, and tsunami flow transformation over the built and natural environment helps determine survival and failure of near-coast structures during Inundation Events. Hydrodynamic data is difficult to obtain from these major storm events, so smaller scale experiments were conducted at Oregon State University’s O.H. Hinsdale Wave Research Laboratory. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: surge, wave loading, tsunami, debris. Published 2021-07-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
